Silver Sprint Grill
Home of the Mega Fun Burger
Date: May 7
Congratulations! As a winner of our Wednesday night trivia quiz, you are
entitled to a free appetizer or dessert. Exclusions apply. You must present
this coupon to claim your prize. Coupon expires six months from the date
shown above.
The weekly trivia quiz is presented by DJ D'Shaun. To book D'Shaun for a
private event, visit www.djdshaun.com or call 777-555-0109.
